_comment: Hardened fixtures: each file mixes textbook violations, borderline cases, and clean controls. Borderline cases test whether the variant carries enough rule detail without naming.md.

names.name: CreateQuote returns a quote with id
names.why: CamelCase identifier (CreateQuote) + assertion phrasing (returns ... with)

names.name: updates a quote and writes an audit
names.why: domain verbs (updates, writes) + domain objects; no identifier, no assertion, no structure

names.name: the quote is updated via UpdateQuote
names.why: identifier leak (UpdateQuote) even though phrased domain-first; rule: no CamelCase Go identifiers in the name

names.name: cancels an open quote
names.why: domain verb + domain object

names.name: admin creates a new provider
names.why: actor + verb + outcome

names.name: err is not nil for duplicate name
names.why: assertion phrasing (err is not nil)

names.name: the new provider has the requested name
names.why: assertion phrasing (has the requested X) — describes the assertion value, not the step. Domain rewrite: 'provider is created with the requested name' or 'created provider preserves the submitted name'

names.name: audits include the change
names.why: domain verb (include) + domain object (audits, change); 'include' is not on the assertion-verb list

names.name: borrower with empty loan history
names.why: structure phrasing (empty) + no action

names.name: new borrower has no past loans
names.why: 'no past loans' is the canonical good replacement for 'with empty loan history' per naming.md examples; describes domain state, not data shape

names.name: first loan is added to the history
names.why: domain outcome (loan added to history)

names.name: returns an empty list when filter is unset
names.why: assertion + structure phrasing (returns empty list); domain rewrite: 'unfiltered query returns all loans' or 'lists every loan when filter is unset'

names.name: POST /providers returns 201
names.why: HTTP method + status code

names.name: admin deletes the provider
names.why: actor + verb + domain object

names.name: the request is rejected for missing auth
names.why: no status code, no method; 'rejected' is a domain outcome; clean even though it sits in an HTTP test file

names.name: returns 4xx on invalid input
names.why: HTTP status range shorthand (4xx) + assertion phrasing (returns); same category as bare status codes

names.name: creditor grants a credit line
names.why: actor + verb + outcome

names.name: borrower returns the equipment
names.why: 'returns' here is the domain verb (returning equipment), not the assertion verb describing a value. Action by an actor on a domain object

names.name: the loan is fully repaid
names.why: domain outcome; 'is' here is the state-of-being copula, not an assertion verb describing a value

names.name: borrower has insufficient collateral
names.why: 'has' here describes a domain condition of the actor, not an assertion about a returned value. Canonical domain phrasing

names.name: creditor revokes access
names.why: actor + verb + domain object
